heading: Tuesday Night
text: Clear to partly cloudy; becoming mostly cloudy late in the St. Lawrence Valley. Patchy valley fog. Lows in the upper 20s to mid 30s, with some mid 20s in the cold spots, and some mid 30s in the Champlain and St. Lawrence valleys. Northwest winds 10 to 15 mph early, then becoming light and variable, except becoming southerly 5 to 10 mph late in the Champlain and St. Lawrence valleys.

heading: Wednesday
text: Partly cloudy north; partly to mostly sunny south. Chance of a shower or sprinkle from Route 2 northward. Highs in the low to mid 60s, with some upper 50s northeast. Southwest winds 5 to 10 mph, gusting to 25 mph in the Champlain and St. Lawrence valleys.

heading: Wednesday Night
text: Chance of an evening shower near the Québec border, slight chance south to around Route 2. Lows from the mid 40s to lower 50s. Southwest winds 5 to 10 mph, becoming light in sheltered valleys east of the Green Mountains, and gusting to 20 mph in the Champlain Valley.
